spec.description:
Bradford Multitel Foil-Faced is a lightweight, flexible
glasswool insulation blanket factory-laminated with a reinforced aluminium foil
facing, specifically engineered for the external thermal and acoustic wrapping
of commercial and residential air conditioning ductwork. Manufactured by
spinning molten glass containing up to 65% recycled content into fine
bio-soluble fibres, it limits energy losses, controls condensation, and dampens
fan noise traveling through duct systems. Also utilised as a bushfire ember
protection blanket (Multitel BAL 12.5-40), it achieves non-combustibility and
complies with Australian Standard AS 4254 for HVAC ductwork.
features:
Factory-laminated with reinforced aluminium foil facing to provide an effective
vapour barrier

Designed for the external wrapping of heating, ventilation,
and air conditioning (HVAC) ducts

Substantially reduces duct heat gain/loss
and dampens airborne fan noise

Non-combustible glasswool core complying with
AS 1530.1

Multitel BAL version certified to seal gaps against ember ingress
up to BAL-40 under AS 3959

Lightweight and highly flexible for easy wrapping
around circular and rectangular ductwork

Made from bio-soluble FBS-1
glasswool containing up to 65% recycled glass

Low VOC emissions and zero
Ozone Depleting Potential (ODP)

Meets AS 4254 requirements for ductwork
insulation

spec.sustainability:
Manufactured from up
to 65% recycled glass; bio-soluble FBS-1; zero ODP; low VOC
install: Ensure external duct surface is clean, dry, and free of grease or debris

Cut
Multitel blanket allowing sufficient length to wrap around duct perimeter
plus 50mm foil overlap

Wrap blanket snugly around the duct with the foil
facing outward

Seal all longitudinal and transverse foil seams with 75mm
Bradford reinforced aluminium foil tape

Squeegee tape down firmly to ensure a
complete, airtight vapour seal

Secure blanket with outward-clench staples,
tape, or plastic/metal strapping at 300-400mm centres

Avoid compressing the
blanket significantly across corners to maintain rated thermal resistance
selection_checklist:
Confirm ductwork insulation requirement (external
thermal/condensation wrapping)

Determine required R-value (R0.7, R1.0, R1.3,
or R2.0) per NCC / AS 4254 energy efficiency tables

Calculate total surface
area of rectangular and circular ducting

Ensure matching 75mm reinforced
aluminium foil tape is included for joint sealing

For bushfire roof
applications, specify Multitel BAL 12.5-40 (300mm width rolls)
limitations:
For external duct wrap
only; not suitable as internal duct acoustic liner exposed to high-velocity
airflow (use Supertel/Flexitel)

Operating temperature of foil facing must not
exceed 120°C

Must not be left exposed to direct sunlight (UV) or outdoor
weather without protective cladding

problem_keywords: heat loss through air conditioning ducts
use_cases:
Externally wrapping rectangular and spiral
sheet-metal air conditioning ducts in commercial and residential ceiling
spaces

Preventing condensation and heat gain on supply air ductwork in
unconditioned roof cavities

Sealing roof valleys, gutters, and ridge joints
against ember attack in BAL 12.5 to BAL-40 bushfire zones
not_for:
Internal duct acoustic lining with moving airflow (use Bradford Supertel or
Ultratel)
retrieval.rag_summary:
Bradford Multitel Foil-Faced is a flexible,
lightweight glasswool HVAC blanket factory-laminated with a reinforced aluminium
foil vapour barrier, designed for the external thermal and acoustic wrapping of
air conditioning ductwork. Available in thicknesses from 25mm to 75mm (R0.7 to
R2.0) in 1200mm wide rolls, it prevents duct sweat/condensation, reduces energy
losses, and dampens airflow noise. Also produced in a 300mm width as Multitel
BAL 12.5-40 for sealing roof ember entry points, it features a non-combustible
core to AS 1530.1 and complies with AS 4254 ductwork standards.
